Pesticides and Pesticides Residue Analysis Sectional Committee, FAD I

FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides and Pesticides Residue Analysis Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and-Agriculture Division Council. Cymoxanil + Mancozeb wettable powder is a fungicide for agricultural use. Cymoxanil + Mancozeb wettable powder is manufactured to contain cymoxanil 8 percent m/m and mancozeb 64 percent m/m. In preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the provisions of the Insecticide; Act, 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However, this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under the Insecticides Act and Rules, wherever applicable. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with 1S 2: 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised)'. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

technical and -mancozeb technical, together with suitable carrier(s) stabilizer(s) and other formulant(s). 3.1.2 Cymoxanil and mancozeb technical employed in the manufacture of the material shall conform to IS 15600 and IS 8707. 3.2 Physical The material shall comply with the physical requirements specified in 3.2.1 to 3.2.4. 3.2.1 Description The material shall be a free flowing yellow coloured homogeneous powder. It shall wet readily on mixing with water, providing a suspension suitable for use as spray. 3.2.2 Sieving Requirement When determined by the method specified in 11.1 of IS 6940, the amount of material passing through 75 micron 1Ssieve [ IS 460( Part 1 )], should not be . . less than 98 percent by mass. 3.2.3 Suspensibility The suspensibility should -be not less than 60 percent by mass, when tested by the method specified in 11.2 of IS 6940. 3.2.4 Wettubility The time when the whole material gets completely submerged in water should not exceed 120 seconds when tested by the method specified in 11.4 of 1S6940. 3.3 Chemical The material shall also comply with chemical requirements specified in 3.3.-1 to 3.3.3 and 6. 3.3.1 The nominal cymoxanil and mancozeb content shall be declared. When determined by the method prescribed in Annex A of IS 15600 for cymoxanil content and IS 8707 for mancozeb content, the observed cymoxanil, percent (m/m) and mancozeb content, percent (m/m) of any of the samples shall not differ from the declared nominal value by more than the percent tolerance limits indicated below:

This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for combination formulation of cymoxanil + mancozeb wettable powder. 2 REFERENCES The following standards contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:

When tested by the method specified in 11.3.2 of IS 6940, the acidity ( as H,S04 ) of the material shall not be more than 0.5 perc&t by mass. 3.3.3 Alkalinity When tested by the method specified in 11.3.3 of IS 6940, the alkalinity ( as NaOH ) of the material shall not be more than 0.5 percent by mass. 4 PACKING The material shall be packed in trilaminated pouches comprising of Kraft paper or polyester, aiuminium foil and LDPE 100 gauge. The pouches shall be heat sealed to make it leak proof and pilfer proof. The trilaminated pouches upto 500g capacity shall be inserted in card board/carton as per IS 6604. All types of containers shall further be packed in Corrttgated Fiber Board Boxes as per IS 2771 ( Part 1 ). The container shall also comply with the general requirements specified inIS8190 ( Part 1 ). 5 MARKING
5.1 The containers shall bear legibly and indelibly the following information in addition to the information as is necessary under the Insecticides Act, 196.8 and Rules framed thereunder:

The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark. 5.2.1 The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder, The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards. 6 SAMPLING When a bulk quantity of the material is offered for inspection, representative samples of the material shall be drawn as prescribed in IS 10627 and if tested within 90 days of its manufacture, the criteria for conformity shalI be the contents in percent (m/m), shall not be less than the declared nominal value. The upper limit for conformity shall be the same as those given in 3.3.1. When the material is offered for inspection after 90 days of its manufacture, sampling shall be done as prescribed in IS 10627, however, the criteria for conformity of the material shall be the limits of tolerance given in 3.3.1. 7 TESTS 7.1 Tests shall be carried out by the methods referred to in 3.2.2 to 3.2.4 and 3.3.1 to 3.3.3. 7.2 Quality of Reagents Unless ~pecified otherwise, pure chemicals and reagent grade water ( see IS 1070 ) shall be employed in tests.
NOTE -- `Pure chemicals' shall mean chemicals that do not contain impurities, which affect the results of analysis.

Review of Indian Standards

Amendments are issued to standards as the need arises on the basis of comments, Standards are also reviewad periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are neecled; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision. Users of Indian Standards should ascertain that they are in possession of the latest amendments or edition by referring tothe latest issue of `B[S Catalogue' and `Standards : Monthly Additions'.
